about.text: Blueprint: the network, drawn. Fine ink outlines on a faint grid, square corners and no shadows. Pages sit on one wire in the side rail and the open page is the filled node. IBM Plex Sans, Plex Sans Condensed and Plex Mono, Ocean colour by default. Use the Theme tweak for light and dark.
